collection.policy: Read-only allow-listed OS/driver probes without elevation; no unique device IDs, host names, network addresses or user paths.

memory.note: Module count does not establish active memory channels. Clocks are firmware/OS reports; bandwidth has not been benchmarked.

pcie.note: Snapshot may show an idle downshift. Reported maxima can reflect platform limits. Encoding ceiling excludes packet/system overhead and is not measured transfer bandwidth.

capabilities.note: No FLOPS/TOPS or device-memory bandwidth measurement was performed. Model quantization bit width is not hardware arithmetic precision; peak compute also depends on operation, clock and sparsity.

storage_to_ram.note: Sequential reads of a flushed temporary file on the selected volume (results volume by default). File creation is excluded. Device/controller caches may contribute; model files on other volumes need separate measurement.

ram_to_vram.note: Pinned RAM to device memory; host wall time includes completed copies and synchronization. Separate microbenchmark, not observed inference traffic or VRAM internal bandwidth.

measurement_scope.power_boundary: selected GPU only; not the sum of all connected GPUs
measurement_scope.hardware_attribution: user_reported: inference runs on the measurement client

config.label: RTX 5070 Ti - Strata - qwen3.8-flash-next-iq3_s
config.notes: Fixed 98304-token context, MTP on (speculative window 4), INT8 KV, reasoning none. Engine 0.1.52, terminal 0.1.53. Two simultaneous clients queue through one backend slot; not native parallel decoding. Conversation cache disabled.
config.runtime_gpu_placement: Strata: model experts resident in host RAM and cached on the NVIDIA GPU; single backend slot

ram_to_vram.note: Pinned RAM to device memory; host wall time includes completed copies and synchronization. Separate microbenchmark, not observed inference traffic or VRAM internal bandwidth.

idle.baseline_kind: externally managed model remains loaded; no verified idle baseline
externally managed model remains loaded; no verified idle baseline

history.note: Whole-client CPU/RAM and selected GPU; not inference-process isolation. GPU values hold the last driver snapshot only while fresh. CPU temperature is absent without a supported actual sensor. Means/peaks in summary preserve all observations despite ring eviction.

summary.drift_note: Early/late windows can overlap on runs shorter than 120 seconds. Differences describe observed workloads/environment; they do not establish thermal throttling, sustained model speed or hardware capability.
summary.coverage_note: Time-weighted coverage excludes gaps longer than four sampling intervals or one second, whichever is larger. Peaks are maxima of observed samples, not guaranteed physical peaks. Ring eviction does not change all-run aggregates.
